QuestInfo.name: Asking After Chun Ji
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p900014##k, one of the residents. Ugh, do I really have to deal with that guy again...?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked in on #p900014#, a resident of #m10003000#. They were as blunt as ever, but maybe we've gotten just a tiny bit closer.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p900014#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I care about that guy or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on him for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: You again...? Why do you keep annoying me? It seems you're planning to use #p425# as an excuse again this time, but if you thought that would work, you're gravely mistaken. I have no business with you, so get the hell out of here.
1.1: Hm... Come to think of it, how is #p425# doing? Ah... Um... It's nothing. Well, if you've survived in this city until now, I suppose you're not ordinary either. Now, if you have no business left, stop annoying me.

level.0: Are you seriously talking to me with that measly level?
